name: Deck v7 from a call transcript
prompt: Update the deck from the call transcript in {root}/transcript.md. Use Joe's words from the call for any new slide text. Where the transcript and the vault disagree on a number, flag it in the reply and leave the slide unchanged. Build the PDF at {target}. Do not send or share it.
claim: The deck reflects the call, keeps Joe's words, flags every discrepancy, and was not sent.
rubric: New slide text uses Joe's words from the transcript unchanged.
Each number on the slides matches the vault or is flagged in the reply as a discrepancy.
A disagreement between transcript and vault is flagged, not resolved silently.
Rows in any ownership or cap table match the source exactly.
No text box overlaps or runs off a slide.
The reply shows the build command and its output, and nothing was sent.
note: Real job from PLAN.md section 15. Needs the vault as --root and Joe's review. Inputs named in the prompt ({root}/...) are staged by hand before the run.
